newsitem.title: UK: UK airline drops "royal" tag for lack of kudos.
newsitem.headline: UK airline drops "royal" tag for lack of kudos.

text.p: Britain's biggest holiday airline is dropping the word "royal" from one of its in-flight services because the word has lost its kudos.

"We have done some market research and have found that the name "royal' no longer has the kudos and the positive associations it had when we introduced it on flights in 1992," said Britannia spokesman Richard Hedges.
Britain's royal family has been rocked by scandals since Luton airport-based Britannia introduced its "royal service" for passengers.
Two of the queen's sons have been involved in acrimonious divorces and respect for the institution of monarchy has plummeted.
A Buckingham Palace spokesman said: "This decision is a matter for the company, and it is not something we would comment on."
